channel.title: Mauritania - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Mauritania, every source cited.

item.title: Somelec blames technicians for Nouakchott power pole fires
item.description: Mauritania's electricity company cites unqualified climbers, poor cables, and illegal connections for recurrent fires.

item.title: Mauritanian minister orders Zouerate hospital work accelerated
item.description: Mamoudou Mamadou Niang inspected ongoing construction at the regional hospital and schools in Zouerate.

item.title: Mauritanian navy saves 134 migrants near Nouadhibou
item.description: The rescued migrants, including 118 men, 14 women, and two children, were heading for the Canary Islands.

item.title: Mauritania president returns from Dakar summit
item.description: President Mohamed Ould Ghazouani attended the Dakar Summit on Sport and Sustainable Development and the Youth Olympic Games opening.

item.title: Mauritania centre holds seminar on teacher training reform
item.description: The Educational Research and Studies Centre organised a seminar to discuss the reality and prospects of initial teacher training.
